name: Arujino Enji
source: The protagonist. He is a second-year student at Nanigashi Private Academy. He loves maids and boobs, and dreams of becoming a master and living a life surrounded by maids. He is always striving to be a good master, and his grades are among the highest in the school. He is also very good-natured and polite, and his parents (especially his mother) highly appreciate him. While playing his daily maid social game at the maid café, "Princess Seal", where his childhood friend [url=/c116127]Mei[/url] works part-time, he draws an Ultra Hyper Rare Otherworldly Transfer Gacha and is teleported to the maid country, Fifrecia, with Mei and her mother, [url=/c116151]Maasa[/url].
